# Penny Royal — Qwen3.8 on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell

> SGLang-derived runtime for long-context local agents on one or two NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs: Flash-Next NVFP4 with FR-Spec and adaptive native NEXTN MTP, or Qwen3.8-27B FP8 with DFlash2.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000
Display name: Penny Royal. CLI, API model name, paths and package identifiers
keep the existing `pennyroyal` spelling.

Penny Royal 3.0 was released October 10, 2026 as `pennyroyal-v3.0.0`.
Read release-3.0.json for implementation details, measured configuration and
validation. The container workflow builds `ghcr.io/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000:v3.0.0`
from that tag; check its build status before pulling a newly published release.

## Hardware and profiles

The inference target is RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (SM120), TP1 or TP2. Ampere and
Ada Lovelace are retained in the narrowed build for optional sidecar image
preprocessing, not as alternative inference targets. CPU image processing is
also available. Other GPU build targets are trimmed for a slimmer release and
easier downloads. Local 3.0 performance measurements use TP1; community TP2
measurements are attributed separately.

Both profiles support 524288-token context, tools, reasoning, images, RAM
HiCache and optional NIXL disk caching. NIXL is on by default; disabling it
preserves GPU/RAM caching. NVMe PLE is an independent placement choice.

Flash-Next uses the checkpoint's own NEXTN MTP head. The selected 3.0 default
adapts **only C1** between four- and eight-token draft windows. At C2 and
above, speculative decoding continues at fixed W4. Configured capacity C6
does not prevent adaptation when only one request is active. C is request
concurrency, independently of the TP GPU count. Eligible Flash-Next SM120 launches automatically select
the accepted rowwise-FP8 dense format and small-batch kernels. FR-Spec is
part of the default and the qualified adaptive configuration, not an alternative
to adaptation. It stays on at C1 and C2+; only draft-width adaptation is C1-only.
FR-Spec reduces the draft vocabulary, while the target retains its full vocabulary. The measured checkpoint is jpezzulli/OrcaRouter-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored-ModelOpt-NVFP4.
The 27B profile requires its separate DFlash2 draft checkpoint.

## Installation

The baseline paths are native source installation or a prebuilt container
with ordinary host run/configuration files. Configuration lives outside the
image: run.sh selects the image/devices/mounts; the host startup directory is
mounted read-only at /config and executed there. Models and writable caches
have separate mounts. Edit host files and restart to change settings; keep
them when upgrading the image. No image rebuild or Compose setup is required.

The beta configurator is optional. It writes new timestamped files and prints
the exact launch/check commands. Existing saved files remain unchanged. Follow
the generated paths rather than assuming the default file was overwritten.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/README.md): Overview, model choices, current results and setup links.
- [Container](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/docker/pennyroyal/README.md): Prebuilt image, external startup files, GPU visibility and mounts.
- [Native build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/BUILD.md): Install or upgrade the runtime and its dependencies.
- [Native launch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/RUN.md): Model/cache paths, startup, TP selection and API checks.
- [Beta configurator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/CONFIGURE.md): Optional setup assistant and saved-file behavior.

## Performance and release details

Use SGLang's native reported generation throughput for headline tok/s. Mean is
elapsed-time weighted over complete active decode intervals; peak is the
highest native sample from the same window. Include reasoning. Exclude the
first idle/prefill-crossing interval and partial boundaries consistently.
Client wall time and kernel-only timing are separate metrics. C4/C6 figures
are aggregate, not per-request rates. Use normal non-greedy sampling and record
the actual reasoning settings. A synthetic agent transcript is not a real
tool workflow.

- [3.0 release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/RELEASE_NOTES_3.0.md): Human-readable changes and direct contributor acknowledgements.
- [3.0 machine-readable release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/release-3.0.json): Features, source identity, measurements, validation scope and container build status.
- [Results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/RESULTS.md): Measurement rules, current results and dated benchmark history.
- [Community results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/COMMUNITY-RESULTS.md): Reports from other users, including TP2.
- [Changes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/CHANGES.md): Release history and technical lineage.
- [Provenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/PROVENANCE.md): Source/package/checkpoint identities.
- [Validation suite](https://github.com/jpezzulli/pennyroyal-validation): Maintained reasoning, tool, image and performance tests.

Penny Royal did almost all the coding for 3.0, including ports and integration;
John, Penny and Codex collaborated on architecture, source investigation,
tuning and debugging, including fused kernels and decode-cycle measurements.

- [Online FP8](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/FP8.md): Weight representation, automatic selection and historical measurements.
- [NVMe PLE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/NVME-PLE.md): SSD-backed PLE placement.
- [Backends](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/BACKENDS.md): Attention, GDN, MoE and speculative execution paths.
- [Memory and persistence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/MEMORY-AND-PERSISTENCE.md): Allocation, complete hybrid state and cache namespaces.
- [Limitations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/LIMITATIONS.md): Known issues and hardware considerations.
